    extractor = NRKPlaylistIE()

    extractor = NRKPlaylistIE()
    html = """
        <html>
            <head>
                <meta property="og:title" content="Sample NRK Title" />
            </head>
            <body></body>
        </html>
    """
    title = extractor._extract_title(html)
    assert title == "Sample NRK Title"

    extractor = NRKPlaylistIE()
    invalid_url = "https://www.example.com/some/other/page"
